name: WowAddons – Product Addons and Product Options With Custom Fields
author: WPXPO

sections.description:
WowAddons lets you build product options without code. Assign option sets to individual products, categories, or all products; reorder fields; set required choices and conditions; and show added costs as customers make selections. Customer choices appear in the cart, checkout, and order.

Watch the Plugin in Action – Know the Power of WowAddons!

View demo | Documentation | WowAddons Pro

Free product option fields

  • Text Field: Collect short text, such as a name for engraving.
  • Text Area: Collect longer instructions or messages.
  • Number: Request a numeric value.
  • Email: Collect an email address.
  • Telephone: Collect a phone number with a country dial code selector.
  • URL: Request a website or other link.
  • Radio: Show a single-choice list.
  • Checkbox: Allow one or multiple selections, with minimum and maximum controls.
  • Switch: Show a toggle choice.
  • Dropdown: Put choices in a select menu.
  • Range Slider: Let customers choose a number within a range.
  • Color Picker: Let customers select a color.
  • Date: Let customers choose a date.
  • Time: Let customers choose a time.
  • Date & Time: Collect both in one field.
  • Upload: Accept JPG, JPEG, and PNG customer files.
  • Formula: Calculate an add-on price with the existing basic formula field.
  • Heading: Add a label or heading within an option set.
  • Content: Add explanatory content.
  • Popup: Reveal extra content in a popup.
  • Shortcode: Display shortcode-generated content.
  • Section: Group related fields.
  • Separator: Divide groups visually.
  • Spacer: Add space between fields.

Free features

  • Flexible assignment: Show option sets on selected products, categories, or all products.
  • Conditional logic: Show or hide supported fields based on customer choices or product attributes.
  • Pricing: Add fixed, percentage, or per-character charges; update the displayed price as shoppers select options.
  • Builder and styling: Drag, reorder, duplicate, and edit fields; publish or save option sets as drafts; style their product page display.
  • Validation and orders: Set required fields and choice limits; carry selections and uploads through the cart, checkout, and order.
  • Analytics: Track views, clicks, add-to-cart actions, orders, and sales for option sets.

Pro product option fields

With a compatible free plugin and an active Pro license, WowAddons Pro adds:

  • Font Picker: Offer font choices, including uploaded custom fonts.
  • Advanced Formula: Calculate prices from other field values using expressions and functions.
  • Advanced Button: Present choices as styled buttons.
  • Advanced Image Swatches: Present image-based choices.
  • Advanced Color Swatches: Present color-based choices.
  • Advanced Products: Offer other store products and variations as selectable add-ons.

Pro features

  • Live Personalizer: Let customers personalize products with custom text, uploaded images, fonts, and colors while seeing their changes in a live product preview. Add and position text and image elements on product images, connect them with product option fields, and configure their appearance and conditional visibility. Customers can preview their personalized products before purchasing, and the generated mockup is saved with the cart item and order.
  • Option images and previews: Add images to supported choices and show enlarged previews for Radio, Checkbox, and Switch options.
  • Sale Price and Same Price: Discount individual choices or apply one price across a field’s options.
  • Option Descriptions: Explain individual choices in the option list or image preview.
  • Quantity Selector: Let shoppers choose an add-on quantity.
  • Formula Value: Calculate a field’s price from a formula; Advanced Formula provides a separate expression-based field.
  • Additional pricing modes: Charge per unit, word, or character excluding spaces.
  • URL Key: Prefill supported fields through a product link.
  • Repeatable Section: Let shoppers add the same group of fields multiple times.

Learn how easy it is to add custom product add-ons to your WooCommerce store!

Here’s another great video on the ins-and-outs of the features of WowAddons. It’s going to give you a 360-degree view of the custom product fields offered by WowAddons:

Privacy

WowAddons stores option set statistics and customer selections on your site. Views and clicks use local cookies named prad_cookie_sc_* (up to 18 hours) and prad_cookie_cl_* (up to 16 hours). The cookies contain a fixed marker, not customer input. Server rate limits and duplicate checks use short lived, hashed identifiers derived from a visitor’s IP address or user ID; the plugin does not store the readable IP in its statistics tables.

Customer choices are saved with cart items and orders. Upload field files are stored under wp-content/uploads/prad_option_files/ and linked from orders. Anyone with an exact file URL can access that file. Files that do not reach an order are deleted after 365 days by default; a store setting can change or disable that period. Ordered files remain until a store retention period is set. Scheduled cleanup depends on WordPress cron running.

With Pro, the Live Personalizer also saves a generated preview image with the cart item and order. The plugin adds suggested wording to Settings > Privacy > Policy Guide; store owners should adapt their own privacy policy to their use of these fields.

External services

YouTube

Opening an optional tutorial in the builder loads a YouTube embed. Google/YouTube then receives the browser’s IP address and request information and may set cookies. No YouTube request is needed to use product options. YouTube terms | Google privacy policy

WPXPO licensing and updates (Pro only)

When Pro is active, license activation, deactivation, and periodic validation contact account.wpxpo.com, sending the license key, site URL, and product identifier. Pro update checks contact the same service. These requests support license status and plugin updates. WPXPO privacy policy

Pro can also install or update its required free plugin from WordPress.org; those requests are governed by WordPress.org privacy information. The free plugin itself does not send customer option data to WPXPO.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add New, search for WowAddons, and install and activate it.
  3. Open WowAddons to create an option set and assign it to products.

Requires WordPress 6.8 or later and PHP 7.4 or later.
sections.faq:
Can I assign options to specific products?

Yes. Assign option sets to products, categories, or all products. Tag and brand assignment requires Pro.

What files can customers upload?

The free version accepts JPG, JPEG, and PNG. Pro supports additional file types, subject to its settings and validation.

Can I charge for selections?

Yes. Free options can add regular prices to the product. Pro adds sale prices and more pricing controls.

Does WowAddons require coding?

No. Create and arrange fields in the builder.

1.9.2 – 26th November 2026

  • New: The Upload field shows a check mark when a file finishes uploading.
  • Fix: File uploads and the statistics counter keep working on product pages served from a page cache after the page’s security token has expired. They now use the standard WordPress REST nonce.
  • Fix: The Date Picker no longer stops working when its disabled weekdays or dates are not saved as a list.

1.9.1 – 19th November 2026

  • Update: The styles of the product page, cart and checkout are now generated by the plugin from your saved design settings. The plugin no longer stores CSS text sent by the browser. Existing designs keep their look.
  • Update: The statistics counter and the file upload, which are open to visitors, now check that the option set is published and shown on that product, count a visitor once per hour, and limit each visitor by number and total size of uploads. A cap on the temporary upload folder keeps it from filling the disk. Stores can change the limits with filters.
  • Update: The affiliate parameter is removed from upgrade links.
  • Update: The notice dismissal data uses WordPress’s own transient functions instead of direct database queries.
  • Fix: The builder screens now load every script they depend on.
  • Fix: Text shown in the builder, such as option names and rich content previews, is sanitized before it is displayed.
  • Fix: The character counters of the Text Field and Text Area fields work on servers without the mbstring extension.
  • Fix: The readme and privacy text now say that uploads that never reach an order are deleted after 365 days, as the plugin does.

1.9.0 – 22nd October 2026

  • Update: The Button, Image Swatches, Color Swatches and Products fields are removed from the plugin, with their builder settings, styles, product page scripts, REST endpoints, cart handling and the “Update product image” setting. They are provided by the Pro plugin as “Advanced” fields.
  • Update: The per-option “Hidden from customers” switch in the builder is removed, as it only existed to hold fields to the old option limits.
  • Fix: The server now checks what a customer posts against the saved option set. Choice fields are priced and labelled from the saved options, a required field must hold a value, and number, range and email values must be valid, so a hand-built request can no longer change an add-on price.
  • Fix: Folders for uploaded files are hardened the same way before and after an order, and the files ask search engines not to index them.
  • Update: The privacy text now says the optional tutorial videos load from YouTube, and that uploaded files are reachable by anyone who has the exact link.

1.8.5 – 6th October 2026

  • New: The add-on editor has separate Publish and Save Draft buttons.
  • Fix: The option REST endpoints now accept only option set IDs, so they can no longer read, change or delete other posts.

  • Update: Options that were hidden in the builder show a button to show them again.
  • Update: The builder and product page scripts have extension points (filters, actions and slots) that other plugins use to add settings, field types, dashboard pages and dashboard menu entries.
  • Update: The quantity input, formula values, category exclusions, repeatable sections and the Advanced Formula product values are removed from the plugin. They are provided by the Pro plugin.
  • Update: The deprecated Button, Image Swatches, Color Swatches and Products fields show a deprecation notice in the builder on every site. Fields made with the Pro plugin’s “Advanced” versions of these fields are only shown while the Pro plugin is active.
  • Update: The plugin’s admin script loads only on its own dashboard, and its product page styles no longer change the box sizing of the theme’s elements.
